entities.observe: A young human, no armor, no weapon, no idea she is the strangest thing in this world. She moves like someone still deciding to be brave. The inn already leans toward her.
entities.friendly_line: Oh - hi! You've got a good face, you know that? Come in, sit down. I'll find you something warm - on the house, probably. Don't tell Lyonette I said that.
entities._comment_stages: Talk_pool lifted verbatim from the S2 dropped-but-authored copy (.superpowers/sdd/fp-handoff/task-s2-social-report.md, Dropped-but-authored). talk_pool_stages + the erin_errand.json hub-topic unlocks (erin_chess/erin_home) lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/erin_stages.json after the re-path wave went green. Stage 3's erin_daily_meal perk stays UNBUILT/flagged (needs the entity_first_use per-waking dialogue seam, not built this task).
talk_pool: Oh! Hi. Sorry - I was somewhere else in my head. You need something? I can usually find something.
Welcome to The Wandering Inn! That's the whole speech. I'm still workshopping the rest of it.
Everything okay? You've got a look. I know that look - I make that look in mirrors.
If you hear yelling about a door later, that's just the inn being the inn. Don't worry about it.

lines: Hey, you! Good timing. I just invented a new way to burn soup. Kidding. Mostly. Sit, sit.
You know you don't have to hover by the door anymore, right? You're basically furniture now. Nice furniture.
Selys asked about you the other day. I said nice things. You owe me one truthful compliment about my pasta.
There you are! Sit down, I'm testing a recipe on you. That came out wrong. WITH you. Testing it with you.
Lyonette hums when she scrubs now. She'd deny it under oath, so don't tell her I said anything. That was you, by the way.
Some days this place is a lot. Then somebody walks in and it's less a lot. You're one of the less-a-lot ones.

talk_pool_stages._comment: One Erin pool-line acknowledging garden_door_unlocked -- she owns the Skill, the PC witnesses. Gated on the SAME `garden_door_unlocked` flag wi_game.gd's sleep() beat banks (last-met-wins ordering: appended AFTER erin_friend_of_the_inn since the K-of-N gate structurally implies resolved_wrong_order is very often already met by the time this fires, though not required -- garden_door_unlocked can also land via cleaned_the_inn+goblins_spared/sign_defended once those get producers). ONE line (the one-entry-array = a landmark-acknowledgment stage convention, same idiom as lyonette_thawed) -- no mechanics readout, no counter numerals, no Skill name (spoiler cutoff: never 'the Magical Door'-class Vol-9 naming for Erin's own Skill either). CONSTRAINT: this stage deliberately repeats every waking until the residue stage below takes over -- it is the game's only signpost toward the new door, so it must keep firing until the player has actually acted on it, never for a fixed number of hearings.
lines: You didn't say anything, so I will: there's a door in the inn that wasn't there yesterday. It's mine. It's — new. Go look, if you want. Just... knock first. Old habit.

talk_pool_stages._comment: The reveal's residue stage (the olesm_after_the_match idiom: once the landmark beat has been acted on, the NPC demotes to normal callback chatter instead of repeating the reveal verbatim forever). Gated on `visited_the_garden` -- the EXISTING resolution accomplishment `garden_exit` banks via on_enter_accomplishment the first time the player walks through the vine door and back out -- rather than a heard-it-once marker, so the reveal keeps signposting until the player has actually SEEN the garden; a player who wanders in without ever talking to Erin also correctly skips straight to this stage (the reveal would be stale for them). Array-order-wins: authored last, wins the moment the gate is met.
lines: Still there this morning. I checked before breakfast. Okay, during. I checked during breakfast.
Take whoever needs it in there sometime. That's what it's for. I think that's what it's for.

dialogue.speaker: Erin
dialogue.text: Welcome to The Wandering Inn! Mind giving that table a wipe?

entities.observe: A human girl playing at composure a size too large for her. Her hands know trays; her chin knows courts. The two have not finished arguing.
entities.friendly_line: Lyonette's chin lifts, then softens despite itself. You're kind. People are not, usually, to the help. ...It is a small thing. It is not nothing. Sit where you like; I'll bring something hot.
entities._comment_pool: Lyonette's base talk_pool (wounded-pride-thawing, warmth-arc SEED; C4/Q2 grows it post-quest -- spec 2.2/3.Q2). She is the game's ONLY pre-existing QA-covered NPC to gain a pool, so dialogue_walkthrough (the sole script that interacts with her -- twice, once per waking across its two sleeps) was re-pathed to ABSORB the first-talk pool DIALOGUE_LINE at idx 0 (waking 1) and idx 1 (waking 3, chatted_with_lyonette then =1) before opening lyonette_tip, mirroring the S4 pooled-NPC re-path pattern. Zero rng, so seed 9 holds.
talk_pool: Yes, I work here. No, I did not always. That is the whole story, and you may have it for the price of a nod.
The floors are clean because I cleaned them. Twice. Mind where you set your boots.
...You said thank you. To me. Hm. Most don't. — Well. Don't let it go to your head.
entities._comment_stages: The one-shot `talk_pool_post` migrated verbatim into the new `talk_pool_stages` seam (social.gd's talk_pool_line, ORDERED array, last-met-wins) -- a RENAME, not a rewrite; ZERO copy changes. One-entry array = stage 2 (`lyonette_thawed`), the shipped thaw: once `resolved_wrong_order` is banked (The Wrong Order settled by any path), her rotating small-talk REPLACES `talk_pool` with these warmer lines. Rotation still keys on chatted_with_lyonette % lines.size(), zero rng. Ships PERK-LESS (stage-tables.md's optional home-topic unlock + optional short-rest perk are both ⚑ user-gated, default OUT -- see HANDOFF).

lines: You covered for me. With the order, I mean. You didn't have to, and you didn't make it a story to tell later. That is... rare. Thank you.
Sit anywhere you like. The good chair by the fire, even. No, I insist — I'm allowed to insist, it's practically my inn too.
I used to think kindness was something people spent on you to get something back. You keep not doing that. It's unsettling. In a good way. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: Lyonette
dialogue.text: Mind the floors, they're just done.

lines: I trained formal, once. Robes, theory, the whole overpriced show. Doesn't come up much anymore, and I like it that way.
You want a tip that's actually useful? Watch the ice before you stand on it. I learned that one the expensive way.
Yvlon says I've gone soft since the inn. I say I've gone SMART. There's a difference, and it involves not getting frostbite on purpose anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Ceria Springwalker
dialogue.text: Ask me about the vault again and I'll start charging Pisces rent.

talk_pool: The inn's quieter than the Guild hall. I'm starting to see why you like it.

Keep your guard up on your off-hand side. Most people forget it exists until something reminds them, and I'd rather you learn it from me than the hard way.
The couch by the fire really is mine. Ceria just likes saying otherwise.

Captain Ceria says I may sit anywhere. I have chosen the corner with two exits.

lines: I was Prognugator, once. Command caste. I was exiled, is the word Klbkch uses. 'Reassigned' is the word I prefer. Neither changes what happened.
I have counted every safe path between here and the pantry door. If you ever need the fastest one, comrade, ask. I keep the count current.
Erin gave me a name for the corner I sit in. She calls it 'Ksmvr's Post.' I have accepted the designation. It is efficient.

dialogue.speaker: Ksmvr
dialogue.text: I am still counting exits. There are still two.
